t: You're looking at the Triton and Dryads Fountain, a sculptural fountain in Queen Mary's Gardens, in Regent's Park. It was made by the sculptor William McMillan, who is known for a number of public statues across the United Kingdom. It also commemorates Sigismund Goetze, an English painter and philanthropist who was born in London and lived from 1866 to 1939. So the fountain is both a work of art and a memorial, and it sits among the flowerbeds of the gardens.
